description:
Find the date(s) of the next occurrence(s) of a principal moon phase (New Moon, First Quarter, Full Moon, Last Quarter) from a starting date.

Use for: "when is the next full moon?", planning around spring tides (which follow new/full moons by 1–2 days).

date.description: Search start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

response_format.description: Output format: "markdown" for a readable summary table, "json" for the complete structured payload.

name: astro_get_next_moon_phase
title: Get Next Moon Phase Occurrence
